verses.1: Sing to the LORD, a new song! Sing to the LORD, all the earth.
verses.2: Praise Jehovah, bless His name, from day to day, for His salvation.
verses.3: Let them be praised in all nations, among all peoples. May their glory spread far and wide.
verses.4: For Jehovah is great and glorious in all places; He is exalted above all gods.
verses.5: For all the gods of the nations are idols, and Jehovah has created the heavens.
verses.6: He has strength and glory before him in his sanctuary.
verses.7: Let there be honor and glory for Jehovah among the nations.
verses.8: They went to Jehovah with reverence, in honor of His name. They came to His courts.
verses.9: Hallow Jehovah in holiness; let all the earth worship Him.
verses.10: Say in the nations, “The LORD is the king. Even if Egypt is strong, it will not be able to defeat them.” Nations will be defeated by those who are righteous.
verses.11: May the heavens rejoice, and may the earth tremble. May the sea rage, and fill it with its waves.
verses.12: All the trees in the forest will be lush and green again.
verses.13: Before Jehovah, for He has come to judge the earth. He will judge Constantinople justly, and nations with righteousness.
